records.expected_h6_rationale: Atomic decomposition preserves market-A reduction, market-B equilibrium, extra-emissions, and net-reduction checks; A88 and A96 remain required and A15 remains forbidden.

official_correction_model_operations.description: Calculate the market-A CO2 decrease from the subsidy-induced quantity change and emissions per unit.
official_correction_model_operations.answer_model_summary: Official correction element: market A quantity reduction times emissions per unit.

official_correction_model_operations.description: Determine market-B old/new equilibrium after the subsidy effect.
official_correction_model_operations.answer_model_summary: Official correction element: recompute market B equilibrium after the subsidy.

official_correction_model_operations.description: Calculate the extra emissions on market B from the changed equilibrium quantity.
official_correction_model_operations.answer_model_summary: Official correction element: market B quantity increase times emissions per unit.

official_correction_model_operations.description: Subtract market-B extra emissions from the market-A decrease to report the net CO2 reduction.
official_correction_model_operations.answer_model_summary: Official correction element: combine both market effects into the final net reduction.

records.expected_h6_rationale: The Armington/profit-max route is decomposed into levy-adjusted MK, revenue/MO, MO=MK quantity, and final domestic price; stale A15/H03/A20 remain forbidden.

official_correction_model_operations.answer_model_summary: Official correction element: construct TO from GO and quantity.

negative_regression_fixtures.rationale: Removing A88 must break the net CO2 reduction operation.
A welfare-region arceer answer must not trigger full graph construction.
The item needs cross-elasticity/substitute reasoning, not own-price elasticity.
Removing D07 must specifically break the airline burden/share operation.
A dominant-strategy explanation alone must not pass the prisoner-dilemma conclusion.
The q23-specific reviewed equivalent does not authorize full graph/function construction.
Reintroducing A15/H03/A20 on an Armington/profit-max correction route must fail.
